topic: top view of binary tree leetcode style , solution video with intitution to optimal with and python code  explanation
narration: Give the root distance zero. Left is minus one, right is plus one. Walk level by level, top down. That's breadth first. Say root ten has five left and fifteen right, and five has seven right. Seven lands on zero too. But zero was already claimed by ten. So you skip it. If it's the first time you see a distance, you keep it.
description: Vertical 1080x1920 2D Manim diagram on dark background. Center 40-65% height: clean binary tree graph with white circles labeled 10 (root top), 5 left, 15 right, 7 right-child of 5, muted-grey edges. Below tree at 68%: horizontal HD number line with -1, 0, +1 in muted-grey, active HD turns accent3-yellow. Bottom-center 72%: horizontal BFS queue bar of rounded rectangles. First-seen HD slots lock accent-cyan, duplicates flash accent2-magenta then fade. Focal node each beat scales up accent-cyan.

beats.action: Tree builds top-down in center, root 10 scales in accent-cyan with HD 0 label accent3-yellow below it
